$comment: Song presets for the progression planner: chord changes only, simplified to the main sections, not full arrangements. 'by' is the best-known recording or the writer of a standard; 'style' groups the picker. Chords are written as a player would type them: '|' between bars, '||' between sections, 'C:2' for a chord held two bars. A chord held longer is written with a length, not repeated, since a repeat counts as a change.
